key.name: max-recording-seconds
key.description: Seconds after which recording stops on its own and the transcription is inserted.

key.name: mistral-api-key
key.description: API key used to authenticate with the Mistral Voxtral realtime transcription endpoint.

key.name: silence-timeout-seconds
key.description: Seconds of uninterrupted silence that end the recording. 0 keeps recording until stopped by hand.

key.name: toggle-recording
key.description: Shortcut that opens the recording overlay, then stops recording and inserts the transcription.

key.name: transcription-delay-ms
key.description: Milliseconds of audio Voxtral buffers before transcribing. Higher values give the model more context and better accuracy, lower values show and insert text sooner.

key.name: typing-speed
key.description: Characters per second used to insert the transcription. Lower it if characters get dropped or reordered.
